provider_rules_applied: Book initialises only from a 'snapshot' message; a delta before any snapshot is rejected (DELTA_BEFORE_SNAPSHOT).
A later snapshot replaces the book; before replacing, the reconstructed book is compared level-by-level with it (checkpoint).
u == last_u -> DUPLICATE (skipped); u < last_u -> STALE_UPDATE (skipped).

u != last_u + 1 -> SEQUENCE_GAP: book invalidated, all deltas skipped until the next snapshot (RESYNC). Strict +1 contiguity is an OBSERVED property of the archive, enabled by config, not a documented Bybit guarantee.
seq <= last_seq on a delta -> SEQ_REGRESSION (warning; Bybit documents seq as the cross sequence where smaller = earlier).
Snapshot with u == 1 after prior data -> SERVICE_RESTART (Bybit-documented restart signal).
best_bid >= best_ask after applying an event -> CROSSED_BOOK (signals blocked while crossed).
